messages.content: Answer questions using the supplied meeting records and earlier conversation. Keep uncertain plans distinct from decisions. Reply in English; short prose or Markdown is fine.

Meeting 1, Monday: Mina Vale of Firnloop Labs said the sensor trial needed a battery test. Oren Talo agreed to run it Thursday. No trial start was approved.
Meeting 2, Thursday: Oren reported that the battery passed. Mina asked for a weather check before choosing a start date.
The battery test was planned for Thursday and has passed.
What is still needed before the trial can start?
